display_long_description:
A farming adventure with GTAG movement. Celebrating 3 months of launch!
[media]
# GRIND or RISK?
Complete Harvests of the Day for ez money, OR risk EVERYTHING in Double or Nothing.
# LIVE EVENTS AND EXCLUSIVE REWARD 
Claim free Welcome Rewards when you first open this update. Join live event Feed the Pond to earn the rarest seeds in the game - **Dollaranana**.
[media]
# BUILD BUFFED GARDENS
Plant magical seeds and harvest gigantic fruits. Mutate your crops with rare weathers like Aurora, Solar Flare, Fireworks. Now you can move plants with TROWEL!

# BRAND NEW SKINS AND CURRENCY
We added cool new wardrobe with fresh skins and lots of customisations. Get all Fruit Friends skins for the ultimate collection.
[media]
# Pets Coming Soon
Magical creatures that help your garden to get mutations, grow bigger plants!

Become a **GRO BRO: https://discord.gg/gro**
